content: {"episode_id":"ep-05267","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that the required authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known sick sinus syndrome; the claim lists diagnoses R55 and I49.5. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings during daily activities. We request reconsideration based on this documented clinical indication."}
